proposed_rules.trigger: An expanded FAQ answer ([region] node) appears as a sibling outside its accordion's parent container in the visual tree, instead of nested under its question, because the page-tree capture promotes absolutely/fixed-positioned open-accordion-panel elements out of their DOM parent.
proposed_rules.decision: When assembling the FAQ accordion block, re-attach any [region] node tagged as promoted-outside-parent to the question row it vertically aligns with (matched by Y-position/order), rather than treating it as a separate top-level section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Third consecutive page-15 instance (after C121, C122) of the same floating-region artifact (rc2c8c3/rc4 here); recommend promoting this pipeline rule to confirmed given the recurrence across the whole page-15 template family.
